# Pmi041 — dimensional_size vs dimensional_location confusion

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.7 (`12-7-pmi`)

## Sources
- 06-nist-sfa (S061), 06-nist-sfa (S039), 17-standards-bodies (M008)

## Description

Common producer-side defects: using `dimensional_location` instead of `dimensional_size` for a hole diameter; using a `dimensional_size.name` or `dimensional_location.name` value not in the AP242 RP table; missing diameter/radius symbol; wrong feature counts for repetitive dimensions; wrong dimension/zone values; missing or wrong datum frames; missing modifiers; missing composite tolerances. The end result is that PMI cannot be machine-consumed downstream.

## Reproducer recipe

Hole-diameter PMI encoded as `dimensional_location` (curved-distance) instead of `dimensional_size`; or `dimensional_size.name = 'curved_distance'` for a flat dimension.

## Expected kernel behavior

Parse as-is; downstream MBD pipeline must validate. Warn loudly when name conventions deviate.
